desc: Precompute divisors for all numbers up to 10^6 to efficiently find all divisors of each A_i.
For each index i, add i to the divisor lists of all divisors of A_i.
For each candidate g from 1 to 10^6, count the number of multiples of g in A (using the precomputed lists).
Iterate g from 10^6 down to 1. For each g, if the count of multiples is >= K, then for each index i in the multiple list of g, if answer[i] is not set, set answer[i] = g.
Read input, run the algorithm, and print the answers for each index.
